title: Apple One gets even better in iOS 27, here’s what’s new - 9to5Mac
summary: Apple One is getting better in iOS 27, with subscribers set to benefit from new features coming to bundled Apple services like iCloud+ and Apple Music. Apple One starts at $19.95/month and includes services like Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+, and more.
